scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,his "dotnet run --project backend/src/Lukas.Api" "pnpm --dir frontend/app dev" "pnpm --dir frontend/app histoire:dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n api,desktop "dotnet run --project backend/src/Lukas.Api" "pnpm --dir apps/desktop tauri dev"
scripts.check: dotnet build backend/Lukas.slnx -m:1 && pnpm --dir frontend/app lint && pnpm --dir frontend/app typecheck
scripts.test: dotnet test backend/Lukas.slnx -m:1 && pnpm --dir frontend/app test
scripts.format: dotnet format backend/Lukas.slnx && pnpm --dir frontend/app format
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:openapi && pnpm api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/app/src/api/generated
